parsed.rationale: Both participating records — `Playcut.stub` in `_Plant_PlaycutStub.swift` and `Talkset.stub` in `PlaylistStubs.swift` — carry `is_test: true`. Per the decision rules, any cluster where even one record is test-marked must be treated as a test-fixture and left alone. Here both records are test fixtures living under `Shared/Playlist/Sources/PlaylistTesting/`, so merging them into a generic stub factory would couple test-support infrastructure in a way that could obscure the distinct domain semantics of `Playcut` vs `Talkset` stubs. No production code is involved, and the structural similarity (Jaccard 0.71) is expected for parallel stub methods in the same testing target.
